locked_gate.legacy_algorithm: cd RUST_STDLIB && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'

resolved_aggregate_evidence.method: the locked build driver hashes the exact GNU sha256sum text transcript of immediate regular files under RUST_STDLIB
resolved_aggregate_evidence.interpretation: The lock is a 64-member closure. The supplied rust-std component supplies the matching 62-member base; the two exact llvm-tools-preview members named by REPAIR_CONTRACT.json complete the locked closure.

allowed_actions: read exact admitted Rust archive members without extracting or executing them
read direct regular files under the already-admitted stdlib directory
invoke only find, sort, xargs, and sha256sum to replay the legacy aggregate transcript
record binary hashes and locale inputs for those host utilities
run materialize_missing_components.py first in dry-run mode and then, only on an exact dry-run result, create-only materialize the two REPAIR_CONTRACT.json members
write create-only receipts and a durable checkpoint
replay the entire immutable Section 0 in a fresh process after the repair receipt reports the locked digest
forbidden_actions: modifying the locked closure digest or build driver
running rustc, cargo, repository Python, JAX, jaxlib, or any archive member
native build, runtime boundary, BASS or REC admission, four-site operator, node replay, restart, formal audit, canonical pilot, or scientific publication
substituting a component, archive, target file, or digest not named by REPAIR_CONTRACT.json
treating this repair receipt as a Section 0 or scientific pass

decision_rules.legacy_shell_python_divergence: STOP_INVALID; retain raw transcript hashes, utility bytes, and locale evidence
decision_rules.base_62_digest_matches_reported_observed: Run only the REPAIR_CONTRACT.json dry run; do not alter the locked driver or closure digest.
decision_rules.repair_dry_run_exact: Apply only the exact declared supplements create-only, then verify the returned 64-member closure digest.
decision_rules.repair_result_matches_locked: Run a fresh complete immutable Section 0 replay before considering any successor.
decision_rules.any_repair_failure_or_conflict: STOP_INVALID; preserve receipts and do not substitute bytes.
